title: Migrate Bahia Nostr code from github.com/nbd-wtf/go-nostr to fiatjaf.com/nostr

excluded_paths: notifications, controlplane reactors/publishers, public pkg/client/pkg/discovery, soul factory, fips bridge, docs publishers, blossom/sbom/signing/signet adapters

intended_behavior: The core canonical Nostr adapter/helper layer uses fiatjaf.com/nostr event, relay, filter, key, signing, validation, NIP-11, and NIP-19 APIs.
Core adapter subscriptions remain event-driven with scoped REQ filters and explicit EVENT/EOSE/CLOSED/AUTH handling.
Publishing continues to verify relay OK outcomes through fiatjaf relay Publish errors and records partial failure metadata.
Inbound events are validated with canonical event ID, Schnorr signature, timestamp, tag, and content checks before persistence or dispatch.
No polling or sleep-based completion logic is introduced for relay event delivery or historical catch-up.
observed_behavior_before: Core adapter files imported github.com/nbd-wtf/go-nostr and relied on string-shaped Event ID, PubKey, Kind, Sig, filter author/kind, and signing APIs.
The repository already had an older fiatjaf.com/nostr module pin but the core adapter layer was still coupled to go-nostr.
implementation_notes: Added internal/nostrutil to centralize canonical fiatjaf private-key decoding, event signing, pubkey derivation, signature hex encoding, kind conversion, and pubkey filter conversion.
Added adapter-local canonical helpers to keep repository string records and domain metadata stable while the relay/event layer uses fiatjaf typed IDs, pubkeys, kinds, and signatures.

Updated RelayPool subscription wrappers for fiatjaf single-filter subscriptions and disabled fiatjaf fake EOSE timeout with MaxWaitForEOSE set to math.MaxInt64 duration, preserving Bahia EOSE semantics.
Updated relay AUTH signing to fiatjaf Auth callback signature and canonical event signing.
Updated core adapter tests and fixtures to use typed fiatjaf events and valid canonical pubkeys where filter scoping is asserted.
